title: Dark energy and quantum gravity may be deeply intertwined

title: Knee osteoarthritis isn’t inevitable - here’s what you can do
desc: Knee osteoarthritis can seriously affect mobility and quality of life, but its progression isn’t completely out of your control. Exercise, stronger leg muscles, a healthier diet, and even modest weight loss can dramatically reduce stress on the knees and help keep pain in check.
